title: 第7课 · 我跟她都认识五年了
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 7 — 我跟她都认识五年了 · I've known her for five years

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在办公室 — In the office

items.py: tóngshì
items.en: colleague

items.py: yǐqián
items.en: before, ago

items.py: yínháng
items.en: bank

items.zh: 同事：那个漂亮的新同事是谁？
items.py: Tóngshì: Nàge piàoliang de xīn tóngshì shì shéi?
items.en: Colleague: Who's that pretty new colleague?

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nà shì Xiǎolì.
items.en: Xiaogang: That's Xiaoli.

items.py: Tóngshì: Tā gāng lái Běijīng ma?
items.en: Colleague: Has she just come to Beijing?

items.zh: 小刚：不，她在北京工作三年了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Bù, tā zài Běijīng gōngzuò sān nián le.
items.en: Xiaogang: No, she's been working in Beijing for three years.

items.zh: 同事：以前她在哪儿工作？
items.py: Tóngshì: Yǐqián tā zài nǎr gōngzuò?
items.en: Colleague: Where did she work before?

items.zh: 小刚：她在银行工作了两年以后来的我们公司。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Tā zài yínháng gōngzuòle liǎng nián yǐhòu lái de wǒmen gōngsī.
items.en: Xiaogang: She worked at a bank for two years before she came to our company.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在休息室 — In the lounge

items.py: jiǔ
items.en: for a long time, long

items.py: gǎn xìngqù
items.en: to be interested in

items.zh: 同事：周末你跟小丽去哪儿玩儿了？
items.py: Tóngshì: Zhōumò nǐ gēn Xiǎolì qù nǎr wánr le?
items.en: Colleague: Where did you and Xiaoli go at the weekend?

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒmen qù chàng gē le.
items.en: Xiaogang: We went singing.

items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐmen chàngle duō jiǔ?
items.en: Colleague: How long did you sing?

items.zh: 小刚：我们唱了两个小时歌，晚上还去听音乐会了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒmen chàngle liǎng ge xiǎoshí gē, wǎnshang hái qù tīng yīnyuèhuì le.
items.en: Xiaogang: We sang for two hours, and in the evening we also went to a concert.

items.zh: 同事：你们都对音乐感兴趣吗？
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐmen dōu duì yīnyuè gǎn xìngqù ma?
items.en: Colleague: Are you both interested in music?

items.zh: 小刚：她对音乐感兴趣，我对她更感兴趣。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Tā duì yīnyuè gǎn xìngqù, wǒ duì tā gèng gǎn xìngqù.
items.en: Xiaogang: She's interested in music, and I'm even more interested in her.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在休息室 — In the lounge

items.py: jié hūn
items.en: to marry, to get married

items.py: huānyíng
items.en: to welcome

items.zh: 小刚：我跟小丽下个月结婚，到时候欢迎你来。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ gēn Xiǎolì xià ge yuè jié hūn, dào shíhou huānyíng nǐ lái.
items.en: Xiaogang: Xiaoli and I are getting married next month. You're welcome to come.

items.py: Tóngshì: Shénme? Jié hūn?
items.en: Colleague: What? Getting married?

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Duì a, tūrán ma?
items.en: Xiaogang: Yes. Is it sudden?

items.zh: 同事：你们不是刚认识吗？
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐmen bù shì gāng rènshi ma?
items.en: Colleague: Didn't you two only just meet?

items.zh: 小刚：我跟她都认识五年了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ gēn tā dōu rènshi wǔ nián le.
items.en: Xiaogang: I've known her for five years already.

items.zh: 同事：你跟她结婚，那我怎么办啊？
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐ gēn tā jié hūn, nà wǒ zěnme bàn a?
items.en: Colleague: If you marry her, what am I going to do?

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在公司门口 — At the exit of the office building

items.py: chídào
items.en: to be late

items.py: bàn
items.en: half

items.py: jiē
items.en: to meet (sb.), to pick up (sb.)

items.py: kè
items.en: quarter (of an hour)

items.py: chà
items.en: to fall short of

items.zh: 小丽：你看看手表，怎么迟到了？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ kànkan shǒubiǎo, zěnme chídào le?
items.en: Xiaoli: Look at your watch. Why are you late?

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Méi chídào a.
items.en: Xiaogang: I'm not late.

items.zh: 小丽：你不是说七点半来接我吗？你迟到了一刻钟。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ bù shì shuō qī diǎn bàn lái jiē wǒ ma? Nǐ chídàole yī kè zhōng.
items.en: Xiaoli: Didn't you say you'd pick me up at half past seven? You're a quarter of an hour late.

items.zh: 小刚：现在不是七点半吗？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Xiànzài bù shì qī diǎn bàn ma?
items.en: Xiaogang: Isn't it half past seven now?

items.zh: 小丽：已经差一刻八点了！我都在这儿坐了半个小时了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Yǐjīng chà yī kè bā diǎn le! Wǒ dōu zài zhèr zuòle bàn ge xiǎoshí le.
items.en: Xiaoli: It's already a quarter to eight! I've been sitting here for half an hour.

items.zh: 小刚：不是我迟到了，是你的表快了一刻钟。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Bù shì wǒ chídào le, shì nǐ de biǎo kuàile yī kè zhōng.
items.en: Xiaogang: It's not that I'm late; your watch is a quarter of an hour fast.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (S + V + 了 + Duration + O (+ 了))

items.en: She worked for three years.

items.zh: 我们坐了一个小时公共汽车。
items.py: Wǒmen zuòle yī ge xiǎoshí gōnggòng qìchē.
items.en: We rode the bus for an hour.

items.py: Nǐ zěnme wǎn dàole yī kè zhōng?
items.en: Why did you arrive a quarter of an hour late?

items.py: Wǒmen chàngle liǎng ge xiǎoshí gē.
items.en: We sang for two hours.

items.py: Wǒ xuéxíle yī nián Hànyǔ le.
items.en: I've been studying Chinese for a year (and still am).

items.zh: 她看了半个小时电视了。
items.py: Tā kànle bàn ge xiǎoshí diànshì le.
items.en: She's been watching TV for half an hour.

items.zh: 他们游了二十分钟泳了。
items.py: Tāmen yóule èrshí fēnzhōng yǒng le.
items.en: They've been swimming for twenty minutes.

items.zh: 我都在这儿坐了半个小时了。
items.py: Wǒ dōu zài zhèr zuòle bàn ge xiǎoshí le.
items.en: I've been sitting here for half an hour already.

items.en: My son isn't interested in playing basketball.

items.zh: 同学们对汉语有兴趣。你们都对音乐感兴趣吗？

items.en: The classmates are interested in Chinese. Are you all interested in music?

items.py: Wǒ duì tā gèng gǎn xìngqù.
items.en: I'm even more interested in her.
